acceptedAnswer.text: It can be caused by hormonal imbalance, genetics, certain medications or excess chest fat. An assessment helps identify the cause.
The procedure is done under anaesthesia. Mild soreness and swelling afterwards are managed with medication and a compression garment.
Most patients return to work within 1–2 weeks, while swelling settles over several weeks. Your surgeon will advise when to resume exercise.

mainEntity.name: Will gynecomastia come back after surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results are long-lasting, especially with a stable weight and healthy lifestyle. Some causes, like medications or hormonal changes, may need ongoing management.
